articles.summary: Analysis of over 16,000 patients switched to HADLIMA ® from HUMIRA® (adalimumab) showed a 1.3% switchback rate over a 12-month follow-up period1 Data demonstrated the switching cohort had an average first-year per-patient pharmacy cost decrease of $8,100 across all indications in the analysis1 The switch resulted in $132 million total estimated savings to the Veterans Affairs Healthcare System1 Organon (NYSE: OGN), a global healthcare company with a mission to deliver impactful medicines and solutions for a healthier every day, today announced the poster presentation of new real-world evidence at the American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Annual Meeting, held November 6-11, 2026 in Orlando, Florida. articles.summary: New pooled post-hoc analysis of Phase 3 data evaluates consistency of VTAMA cream efficacy across diverse atopic dermatitis patient subgroups Organon (NYSE: OGN), a global healthcare company with a mission to deliver impactful medicines and solutions for a healthier every day, today announced that a new analysis of Phase 3 data evaluating VTAMA cream in patients with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (AD) will be presented at the 2026 American College of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology (ACAAI) Annual Scientific Meeting, taking place in Phoenix, Arizona. The analysis evaluates the efficacy of VTAMA cream across diverse patient subgroups based on baseline percent body surface area (BSA) affected and other baseline characteristics.
